question: Does P0623 identify genuine baryonic crowding/path survival, or merely a galaxy-only potential-depth correction that fails for deep but spatially porous clusters?

frozen_candidates.transfer_feature: outward baryonic column; galaxy and Solar only because no equivalent disk column is observed for all derived clusters

frozen_candidates.role: simple density candidate available in every domain
frozen_candidates.transfer_feature: mean baryonic surface density inside R80

parameter_rule: Refit each frozen formula only on P0623 development folds 0-3, once. Hold all parameters and galaxy-derived feature normalization fixed in every transfer domain.

derived_cluster.evaluation: no cluster parameter refit; q_eff may vary by radius only when its frozen galaxy formula is local
derived_cluster.pair_profile_approximation: Treat the smooth spherical baryonic profile as one moment-matched exponential with R_d=R80/3; mark this as a non-porous control, not a measurement of member-level porosity.

raw_cluster.pair_feature: Use cataloged member positions and luminosity weights; include a frozen 2 kpc Gaussian internal member scale and the same 30 kpc kernel.
raw_cluster.potential_feature: Recompute the spherical baryonic potential on the frozen raw profile grid and apply q_eff point by point.
raw_cluster.geometry: fixed P0554 geometry and profiled source positions; no lens geometry or gravity refit
roles_to_run: simple density candidate available in every domain

solar.potential: Use GM_sun/(r c^2) point by point.
solar.surface_density: Use M_sun/[pi (0.8 R_sun)^2] as the compact-source mean surface proxy.
solar.outward_column: Use a spherical compact-source upper-screen approximation and report it as sensitivity only.

decision_rules.potential_only_falsification: If the P0623 potential winner materially worsens the fixed P0554 parent on derived and raw cluster tests, it is a galaxy repair rather than the desired unification.
decision_rules.porosity_support: A pair or surface-density formula must preserve its galaxy gain and outperform potential-only transfer in clusters without per-cluster parameters.
decision_rules.raw_topology: A missing held-out image root is failure, never an RMS improvement.
decision_rules.promotion: Requires galaxy gate, all Solar proxies, complete raw roots, and raw cluster improvement; otherwise retain only as a diagnostic component.

claim_limits: All galaxy and cluster systems are project-spent; this is a mechanism stress test, not external validation.
The 20-system CLASH acceleration target is derived through conventional lens models.
The smooth-profile pair feature cannot measure cluster member porosity; member-level pair geometry is available only in the five raw systems.
Fixed raw lens geometry isolates the formula response but is not a blind full reconstruction.
Solar tests are analytic proxies rather than an ephemeris likelihood.
